verdict.rationale: Zep's official Memory MCP Server lets an end user connect MCP clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to their Zep memory, so the product can be driven in natural language through an external LLM client. ABAC policies govern which actions those Memory MCP users can reach, and Graphiti offers a separate MCP server, though it is marked experimental. Natural-language operation therefore depends on a third-party agent client, and the evidence does not show which operations are exposed beyond memory access. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface (dashboard or CLI), documented coverage of administrative operations via natural language, independent hands-on corroboration.
